run_retrieval_pipeline: run the DPR retrieval pipeline to generate query embeddings and retrieve top passages using FAISS index search
build_faiss_index: build a FAISS inner product index from a list of pickled passage embedding vector files
merge_retrieval_results: merge retrieved passage IDs and scores with question text and passage metadata into structured JSON output
review_merge_results: review the merge_results function that joins passage text with result IDs, questions, and scores
refactor_build_index: refactor the build_index function to support additional FAISS index types beyond IndexFlatIP
